description: Add an IP/CIDR to the blocklist, optionally scoped to a route/method. Write action; requires confirmation.

appKey.description: Optional application key to scope this block. Omit for all apps.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

duration.description: Optional block lifetime instead of expiresAt, for example 15m, 2h or 7d.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

method.description: HTTP method scope. Defaults to ALL.

pathMatchMode.description: Path matching mode. Defaults to prefix.

pathPattern.description: Optional route/path pattern, for example /admin*. Omit to block all routes.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_blocklist_add
title: Add Blocked IP
